[NERR.10.1] Native Rete loader / runtime codes:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_RETP_INVALID`, `DS_ERR_RETP_INDEX_OOB` | an `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode` or `TerminalNode` carrying `node_id` 0 or a repeated `node_id`, or a `left_parent_id` cycle; a node cross-reference not found ([RDSC.11.1]). A body that fails decode is `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` ([RDSC.11.4]) |
| `DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND` | a call expression in the artefact names an op with no builtin; `ds_engine_load_dsc` refuses the artefact |
| `DS_ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED` | a bounded run reached its `max_fires` |

The realtime codes are [NERR.18]'s.

-600 is reserved and never reused ([STYL.2.8.7]): an artefact with no rule
network loads ([RDSC.4a.2]), and one with no `DscHeader` is refused as
[RDSC.11.1] states.
